propositions: CodeHealthConfig.enabled field is declared with default False but has zero read sites in src/rebar, making it inert and non-functional as an off switch

Structural metrics (module_size_distribution, oversized_module_count, complexity_summary, duplication_summary) evaluate regardless of the enabled flag setting because metrics.py never consults it when loading the code_health config

The inert-config gate cannot detect this field because it matches bare attribute names globally and .enabled exists on other configs (ui.enabled, LangfuseConfig), causing this field to pass without verification

Operator decision ruled to REMOVE CodeHealthConfig.enabled rather than wire it, with removal implemented via Gerrit change 1422 including deletion of the field, coercion row, and tombstone entries for backwards compatibility
Two warn-class tombstones (cfg code_health.enabled and env REBAR_CODE_HEALTH_ENABLED) were added to allow still-set inputs to warn and exit cleanly without silently dropping them
